title.narrative: PIMS 10323-PPG Promoting Productive Use of Renewable Energy for MSME and Local Development in Obock Region

description.narrative: The objective of the GEF PPG is to develop the project concept into a full project: Promoting Productive Use of Renewable Energy for MSME and Local Development in Obock Region As described in the project concept (PIF), this project aims to expand access to clean, affordable, and reliable solar energy in Obock’s urban and peri-urban areas. It will deploy distributed solar systems for productive uses of energy, enabling income generation and service delivery, while catalyzing private sector engagement in energy supply. Key outcomes include: 1) Strengthened policy and institutional frameworks, 2) expanded solar value chains and service provision, and 3) improved M&E systems to support replication and scaling.
